End-to-end mobile UI testing with Maestro Studio on Android and iOS
recent_posts.summary: Maestro Studio is a free, open-source desktop application that simplifies UI and end-to-end testing for mobile apps. The walkthrough covers installing Maestro Studio, connecting real Android and iOS devices, creating test flows visually by clicking and right-clicking UI elements, using built-in commands like swipe gestures and random input generation, and running tests locally. It also demonstrates Maestro Cloud, which lets you run the same test flows in parallel across multiple real devices and OS versions (Android API 31/34, iOS 17/18) without owning those devices. CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions and Expo Application Services is also covered, enabling automated test runs on every pull request.

top_posts.title: Run multiple Claude Code agents at the same time without breaking your project #claude #claudecode
top_posts.summary: Git worktrees can be used with Claude Code to run multiple AI coding agents simultaneously without conflicts. By passing the --worktree flag with a branch name, Claude Code creates isolated copies of your project, each on its own branch. This enables parallel agent sessions — one building auth, another fixing bugs, another adding features — all running concurrently with no risk of interfering with each other or the main branch.

top_posts.summary: A comprehensive crash course on Expo Router v5 (SDK 55) covering everything from project setup to advanced navigation patterns. Topics include stacks, tabs, nested navigators, route groups, dynamic routes, typed routes, protected routes, and server-side API routes with middleware. The tutorial demonstrates native iOS liquid glass support, Android material tabs, tab icons with SF Symbols, stack toolbars, and how to structure complex navigation flows with authentication guards.
